examples.en: That buffer is allocated on the heap for every request, which puts a lot of pressure on the GC.
examples.zh: 每个请求都会在堆上分配一次那个缓冲区，给 GC 带来很大压力。

examples.en: Anything you create with new is allocated on the heap, unless escape analysis optimizes it away.
examples.zh: 用 new 创建的东西都在堆上分配，除非逃逸分析把它优化掉。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Java 里的对象存在哪里？线程之间共享吗？
situation.en: Objects are allocated on the heap, which is shared by all threads, while each thread has its own stack.

entries.zh: （局部变量）存在栈上，动词 l 开头

examples.en: Local variables live on the stack, so they're gone as soon as the method returns.
examples.zh: 局部变量存在栈上，方法一返回就没了。

examples.en: Only the reference lives on the stack; the object itself is on the heap.
examples.zh: 栈上只有引用，对象本身在堆里。

situation.zh: 面试官问：方法里的局部变量存在哪里？会被其他线程看到吗？
situation.en: Local variables live on the stack, and each thread has its own stack, so they are never shared.

entries.note: 每个线程有自己的栈；递归太深会抛 StackOverflowError。

examples.en: Most of our objects die in the young generation, so minor GCs are cheap.
examples.zh: 我们大部分对象在新生代就被回收了，所以 Minor GC 开销很小。

examples.en: We made the young generation bigger so fewer objects got promoted too early.
examples.zh: 我们把新生代调大了，这样过早晋升的对象就少了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：新创建的对象一开始放在堆的哪个区域？
situation.en: New objects are allocated in the young generation, mostly in Eden.

entries.term: get promoted to the old generation

examples.en: Our cached objects quickly got promoted to the old generation and stayed there for hours.
examples.zh: 我们缓存的对象很快就晋升到老年代，一待就是几个小时。

examples.en: Objects that survive enough minor GCs get promoted to the old generation.
examples.zh: 熬过足够多次 Minor GC 的对象会晋升到老年代。

situation.zh: 面试官问：长期存活的对象在堆里最后会去哪里？
situation.en: Objects that survive several minor GCs get promoted to the old generation.

entries.note: old generation 也叫 old gen 或 tenured generation。

entries.zh: 短命对象（很快就变成垃圾的对象）

examples.en: The service creates millions of short-lived objects per second, but the young GC handles them well.
examples.zh: 这个服务每秒创建几百万个短命对象，不过 Young GC 处理得很好。

examples.en: Short-lived objects are cheap in Java because allocation is basically a pointer bump.
examples.zh: 短命对象在 Java 里很便宜，因为分配基本上就是移动一下指针。

situation.zh: 面试官问：分代回收为什么有效？
situation.en: It works because most of what we allocate is short-lived objects, so collecting only the young generation reclaims most of the garbage.

entries.note: 反义是 long-lived objects。

examples.en: We switched the garbage collector from G1 to ZGC because we cared more about pause times than throughput.
examples.zh: 我们把垃圾回收器从 G1 换成了 ZGC，因为比起吞吐量我们更在意停顿时间。

examples.en: G1 has been the default garbage collector since Java 9.
examples.zh: 从 Java 9 开始，G1 就是默认的垃圾回收器。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们线上用的是哪种 GC？为什么？
situation.en: We use G1, the default garbage collector, because it gives us predictable pauses on a large heap.

entries.note: 口语里常直接说 the GC 或 the collector。

examples.en: We saw latency spikes every few minutes, and they lined up with long GC pauses.
examples.zh: 我们每隔几分钟就看到一次延迟尖刺，时间点正好和长时间的 GC 停顿对得上。

examples.en: A two-second GC pause is enough to make health checks fail.
examples.zh: 一次两秒的 GC 停顿就足以让健康检查失败。

situation.zh: 面试官问：P99 延迟偶尔飙高，你首先会怀疑什么？
situation.en: I'd check the GC logs first, because long GC pauses often show up as latency spikes.

entries.zh: 全局停顿（所有应用线程都被暂停，s 开头）

examples.en: During a stop-the-world pause, every application thread is frozen, so no request makes progress.
examples.zh: 全局停顿期间，所有应用线程都被冻结，任何请求都推进不了。

examples.en: ZGC does most of its work concurrently, so its stop-the-world pauses are tiny.
examples.zh: ZGC 的大部分工作是并发做的，所以它的全局停顿非常短。

situation.zh: 面试官问：垃圾回收的整个过程中，应用线程都得停着吗？
situation.en: Not for the whole cycle. Modern collectors do most of the work concurrently and only need short stop-the-world pauses.

entries.note: 常缩写成 STW。

entries.zh: 全堆回收（连老年代一起回收的那种 GC，f 开头）

examples.en: The old generation kept filling up, so we were hitting a full GC every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 老年代一直被填满，所以我们每十分钟就来一次 Full GC。

examples.en: With G1, a full GC is a fallback, so seeing one usually means something is wrong.
examples.zh: 对 G1 来说，Full GC 是兜底手段，所以一旦出现通常说明有问题。

situation.zh: 面试官问：线上每隔几分钟就卡顿几秒，GC 日志里你会重点找什么？
situation.en: I'd look for full GCs, because a full GC collects the entire heap and can pause the application for seconds.

entries.zh: 可以被垃圾回收（符合回收条件）

examples.en: Once nothing references the session, it becomes eligible for garbage collection.
examples.zh: 一旦没有任何地方引用这个会话，它就可以被垃圾回收了。

examples.en: Setting the field to null doesn't free memory; it just makes the object eligible for garbage collection.
examples.zh: 把字段设成 null 并不会释放内存，只是让这个对象可以被垃圾回收。

situation.zh: 面试官问：JVM 怎么判断一个对象可以回收？
situation.en: An object is eligible for garbage collection when it's no longer reachable from any GC root.

entries.note: eligible 读 /ˈelɪdʒəbl/，重音在第一个音节。

examples.en: We tracked down a memory leak caused by a static map that was never cleared.
examples.zh: 我们查出了一个内存泄漏，原因是一个静态 Map 从来没清理过。

examples.en: Heap usage after each GC kept climbing, which is a classic sign of a memory leak.
examples.zh: 每次 GC 之后的堆占用还在持续上涨，这是内存泄漏的典型迹象。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Java 有垃圾回收，为什么内存还是会越用越多、最后崩掉？
situation.en: You can still have a memory leak if objects stay reachable, for example through a static collection that keeps growing.

examples.en: I took a heap dump while memory was high and opened it in Eclipse MAT.
examples.zh: 我在内存占用高的时候抓了一份堆转储，用 Eclipse MAT 打开分析。

examples.en: We set the JVM to take a heap dump automatically on OutOfMemoryError.
examples.zh: 我们让 JVM 在发生 OutOfMemoryError 时自动抓一份堆转储。

situation.zh: 面试官问：怀疑有内存泄漏时，你怎么确认是哪些对象占着内存？
situation.en: I'd take a heap dump and look at which objects retain the most memory.

examples.en: The registry still held a reference to every closed session, so none of them could be collected.
examples.zh: 注册表还持有每个已关闭会话的引用，所以它们一个都回收不掉。

examples.en: A ThreadLocal can hold a reference to an object long after the request is done.
examples.zh: 请求早就结束了，ThreadLocal 还可能一直持有某个对象的引用。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这些对象明明已经不用了，为什么 GC 收不掉？
situation.en: Because something still holds a reference to them, so they're still reachable.

entries.zh: 堆空间用光了（动词短语）

examples.en: The export job loaded the whole table into memory and ran out of heap space.
examples.zh: 导出任务把整张表都加载进内存，结果堆空间用光了。

examples.en: We kept running out of heap space until we started streaming the results instead.
examples.zh: 我们一直堆空间不够用，直到改成流式读取结果才好。

situation.zh: 同事问：导出大报表的时候服务为什么挂了？
situation.en: It ran out of heap space because it loaded every row into memory at once.

entries.note: 对应的报错是 OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space。口语里也说 run out of memory 或 hit an OOM。

examples.en: We did some GC tuning, but the real fix was allocating less in the hot path.
examples.zh: 我们做了一些 GC 调优，但真正解决问题的是在热点路径上少分配对象。

examples.en: Most GC tuning starts with setting the heap size and a pause time goal.
examples.zh: GC 调优大多从设置堆大小和停顿时间目标开始。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你调过 JVM 参数吗？具体做了什么？
situation.en: Yes, I did some GC tuning on our order service, mainly the heap size and the pause time goal.

examples.en: We run the report jobs on a separate thread pool so they can't starve the API.
examples.zh: 我们把报表任务放到单独的线程池里跑，这样它们不会把 API 的线程占光。

examples.en: The thread pool was exhausted because every worker was waiting on a slow downstream call.
examples.zh: 线程池被耗尽了，因为每个工作线程都在等一个很慢的下游调用。

situation.zh: 面试官问：为什么不给每个请求都新建一个线程？
situation.en: Creating threads is expensive, so we reuse them through a thread pool and cap how many run at once.

examples.en: SimpleDateFormat isn't thread-safe, so sharing one instance across requests gave us corrupted dates.
examples.zh: SimpleDateFormat 不是线程安全的，所以多个请求共用一个实例时，我们拿到了错乱的日期。

examples.en: The class is thread-safe because all of its state is immutable.
examples.zh: 这个类是线程安全的，因为它的所有状态都不可变。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里把一个 HashMap 放进单例当共享字段，你想提醒他：
situation.en: HashMap isn't thread-safe, so we should use a ConcurrentHashMap here.

entries.note: 名词是 thread safety。

examples.en: Two requests updated the same balance at once, and that race condition cost us real money.
examples.zh: 两个请求同时更新同一个余额，这个竞态条件让我们亏了真金白银。

examples.en: The test only fails once in a hundred runs, which smells like a race condition.
examples.zh: 这个测试跑一百次才失败一次，很像是竞态条件。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个 bug 为什么只在高并发下偶尔出现？
situation.en: It was a race condition: two threads read the counter before either of them wrote it back.

examples.en: The two threads took the locks in opposite order and ended up in a deadlock.
examples.zh: 两个线程以相反的顺序拿锁，最后死锁了。

examples.en: We avoid deadlocks by always acquiring locks in the same order.
examples.zh: 我们始终按同一顺序获取锁，以此避免死锁。

situation.zh: 面试官问：服务完全卡住，CPU 却很低，两个线程都在等对方手里的锁，这是什么问题？
situation.en: That's a deadlock. Each thread is holding a lock the other one needs.

entries.note: 也可以作动词：The two threads deadlocked.

examples.en: Most of our concurrency bugs came from shared mutable state, so we made the handlers stateless.
examples.zh: 我们大部分并发 bug 都出在共享可变状态上，所以我们把处理器改成了无状态的。

examples.en: If you can't avoid shared mutable state, guard it with a lock.
examples.zh: 如果避不开共享可变状态，就用锁把它保护起来。

situation.zh: 面试官问：写并发代码时，你最想避免的是什么？
situation.en: Shared mutable state. If threads don't share anything mutable, you don't need locks at all.

entries.note: mutable 读 /ˈmjuːtəbl/。

examples.en: Each thread has to acquire a lock on the queue before it can touch it.
examples.zh: 每个线程必须先获取这个队列的锁，才能操作它。

examples.en: We acquire the lock with a timeout so a stuck thread can't block everyone forever.
examples.zh: 我们获取锁时带超时，这样卡住的线程不会永远堵住所有人。

situation.zh: 面试官问：两个线程同时调用同一个对象的同步方法，会怎样？
situation.en: Only one of them can acquire the lock; the other one blocks until it's released.

entries.note: 反义是 release a lock；口语里也说 take / grab a lock。

examples.en: Under load, lock contention on that one map became our main bottleneck.
examples.zh: 高负载下，那一个 Map 上的锁竞争成了我们的主要瓶颈。

examples.en: We reduced lock contention by splitting the single lock into one lock per account.
examples.zh: 我们把一把大锁拆成每个账户一把锁，降低了锁竞争。

situation.zh: 面试官问：加了更多线程，吞吐量反而没上去，可能是什么原因？
situation.en: Probably lock contention. The threads spend most of their time waiting for the same lock.

examples.en: I wrapped the update in a synchronized block so only one thread runs it at a time.
examples.zh: 我把这段更新包在同步代码块里，这样同一时间只有一个线程执行它。

examples.en: Keep the synchronized block as small as possible, and never do I/O inside it.
examples.zh: 同步代码块要尽量小，而且绝对不要在里面做 I/O。

situation.zh: 同事问：整个方法都加锁太重了，能不能只锁关键的那几行？
situation.en: Yes, use a synchronized block around just those lines instead of locking the whole method.

entries.note: synchronized 读 /ˈsɪŋkrənaɪzd/。整个方法加锁叫 synchronized method。

examples.en: The critical section was doing a network call, so every other thread piled up behind it.
examples.zh: 临界区里做了一次网络调用，所以其他线程全都堵在它后面。

examples.en: We shrank the critical section to just the counter update.
examples.zh: 我们把临界区缩小到只剩更新计数器那一步。

situation.zh: 面试官问：怎么减少线程等锁的时间？
situation.en: Keep the critical section short, so each thread holds the lock for as little time as possible.

examples.en: We used a reentrant lock instead of synchronized because we needed tryLock with a timeout.
examples.zh: 我们用可重入锁而不是 synchronized，因为需要带超时的 tryLock。

examples.en: With a reentrant lock, the thread that already holds it can acquire it again without deadlocking.
examples.zh: 用可重入锁的话，已经持有锁的线程可以再次获取它，不会死锁。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个同步方法调用同一对象的另一个同步方法，会不会把自己锁死？
situation.en: No, because the intrinsic lock is a reentrant lock: the thread that holds it can acquire it again.

entries.note: reentrant 读 /riːˈentrənt/。Java 里对应的类是 ReentrantLock。

entries.zh: 用 volatile 修饰的字段

examples.en: The shutdown flag is a volatile field, so the worker thread sees the change right away.
examples.zh: 停机标志是一个 volatile 字段，所以工作线程能马上看到变化。

examples.en: A volatile field gives you visibility, but count++ on it still isn't atomic.
examples.zh: volatile 字段能保证可见性，但对它做 count++ 仍然不是原子的。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个线程改了布尔标志，另一个线程的循环却一直不退出，怎么修？
situation.en: Make the flag a volatile field, so every read sees the latest write from the other thread.

entries.note: volatile 美式读 /ˈvɑːlətl/。它只保证可见性和有序性，不保证复合操作的原子性。

examples.en: Incrementing a counter looks like one step, but it isn't an atomic operation.
examples.zh: 给计数器加一看起来是一步，但它并不是原子操作。

examples.en: We switched to AtomicLong so the increment is a single atomic operation.
examples.zh: 我们换成了 AtomicLong，这样自增就是一个原子操作。

situation.zh: 面试官问：多线程下 count++ 为什么会丢更新？
situation.en: Because count++ is not an atomic operation: it's a read, an add and a write, and another thread can get in between.

entries.zh: 比较并交换（CAS 的全称）

examples.en: AtomicInteger uses compare-and-swap under the hood, so it doesn't need a lock.
examples.zh: AtomicInteger 底层用的是比较并交换，所以不需要加锁。

examples.en: If the compare-and-swap fails, we just read the new value and retry.
examples.zh: 如果比较并交换失败，我们就读一下新值再重试。

situation.zh: 面试官问：原子类不加锁，是怎么保证更新不丢的？
situation.en: They use compare-and-swap: the update only succeeds if the value hasn't changed since we read it.

entries.note: 缩写 CAS，逐个字母读。Java API 里的方法名是 compareAndSet。

entries.zh: 先检查再执行（一种典型的竞态写法）

examples.en: Calling containsKey and then put is a check-then-act sequence, and it isn't thread-safe.
examples.zh: 先调 containsKey 再调 put 是典型的“先检查再执行”，不是线程安全的。

examples.en: We replaced the check-then-act code with a single call to computeIfAbsent.
examples.zh: 我们把“先检查再执行”的代码换成了一次 computeIfAbsent 调用。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里先判断 key 不存在、再往 ConcurrentHashMap 里放，你想指出问题：
situation.en: This is a check-then-act race: another thread can insert the key between the check and the put.

examples.en: Without volatile, the other thread might see a stale value and never exit the loop.
examples.zh: 不加 volatile 的话，另一个线程可能读到过期的值，永远退不出循环。

examples.en: The reader thread kept seeing a stale value because reads and writes weren't guarded by the same lock.
examples.zh: 读线程一直读到过期的值，因为读和写没有用同一把锁保护。

situation.zh: 面试官问：如果只给 setter 加锁，getter 不加，会有什么问题？
situation.en: A thread calling the getter could see a stale value, because nothing guarantees it sees the latest write.

examples.en: With dependency injection, the service doesn't create its own repository; the container hands it in.
examples.zh: 用了依赖注入，服务不用自己创建 repository，由容器传进来。

examples.en: Dependency injection made the code much easier to test, because we can pass in fakes.
examples.zh: 依赖注入让代码好测多了，因为我们可以传入假对象。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Spring 最核心的思想是什么？它解决了什么问题？
situation.en: Dependency injection. Objects declare what they need, and the container wires them together, which keeps them loosely coupled.

entries.note: 缩写 DI。相关说法：inversion of control（控制反转，IoC）。

examples.en: We prefer constructor injection because the dependencies can be final and are never null.
examples.zh: 我们更倾向于构造器注入，因为依赖可以声明成 final，而且不会是 null。

examples.en: With constructor injection, you can build the object in a test without starting Spring.
examples.zh: 用构造器注入的话，测试里不用启动 Spring 就能把对象 new 出来。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里给字段加了 @Autowired，你想建议更好的写法：
situation.en: Could we use constructor injection instead? It makes the dependencies explicit and easier to test.

entries.note: 另外两种是 field injection（字段注入）和 setter injection。

examples.en: We hook into the bean lifecycle to load the pricing rules right after the bean is initialized.
examples.zh: 我们利用 bean 的生命周期回调，在 bean 初始化完成后马上加载定价规则。

examples.en: Spring manages the whole bean lifecycle, from instantiation to destruction.
examples.zh: Spring 管理 bean 的整个生命周期，从实例化到销毁。

situation.zh: 面试官问：@PostConstruct 标注的方法是在什么时候执行的？
situation.en: It's part of the bean lifecycle: Spring calls it after the dependencies are injected, before the bean is put into service.

entries.zh: 应用上下文（Spring 的容器）

examples.en: The integration tests are slow because many of them start their own application context.
examples.zh: 集成测试很慢，因为很多测试都要各自启动一个应用上下文。

examples.en: The bean wasn't in the application context because its package wasn't being scanned.
examples.zh: 这个 bean 不在应用上下文里，因为它所在的包没有被扫描到。

situation.zh: 同事问：启动时报 NoSuchBeanDefinitionException 是什么意思？
situation.en: It means Spring couldn't find a bean of that type in the application context.

examples.en: Spring Boot's auto-configuration set up the data source as soon as we added the JDBC starter.
examples.zh: 我们一加上 JDBC starter，Spring Boot 的自动配置就把数据源配好了。

examples.en: The auto-configuration backs off as soon as you define your own bean of that type.
examples.zh: 只要你自己定义了那个类型的 bean，自动配置就会让位。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Spring Boot 为什么几乎不用写配置就能跑起来？
situation.en: Because of auto-configuration: it looks at what's on the classpath and configures sensible default beans for you.

examples.en: We use declarative transactions, so the service methods are just annotated with @Transactional.
examples.zh: 我们用声明式事务，所以服务方法上只要加 @Transactional 注解就行。

examples.en: Declarative transactions keep the commit and rollback logic out of the business code.
examples.zh: 声明式事务让提交和回滚的逻辑不用混在业务代码里。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们的代码里是手动开启和提交事务的吗？
situation.en: No, we use declarative transactions. We annotate the service method, and Spring opens and commits the transaction around it.

entries.note: declarative 读 /dɪˈklærətɪv/。相对的是 programmatic transactions（编程式事务）。

examples.en: We changed the transaction propagation to REQUIRES_NEW so the audit log commits even if the order fails.
examples.zh: 我们把事务传播改成了 REQUIRES_NEW，这样即使订单失败，审计日志也能提交。

examples.en: The default transaction propagation is REQUIRED, which joins the caller's transaction if there is one.
examples.zh: 默认的事务传播是 REQUIRED，如果调用方已经有事务，就加入它。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个带事务的方法调用另一个带事务的方法，里面那个会新开事务吗？
situation.en: That depends on the transaction propagation. With the default, REQUIRED, the inner method joins the existing transaction.

entries.note: propagation 读 /ˌprɑːpəˈɡeɪʃn/。

examples.en: By default, Spring only rolls back the transaction on unchecked exceptions, which surprised the whole team.
examples.zh: 默认情况下，Spring 只在非受检异常时回滚事务，这让整个团队都很意外。

examples.en: If the payment call fails, we roll back the transaction so no half-written order is left behind.
examples.zh: 如果支付调用失败，我们就回滚事务，不留下写了一半的订单。

situation.zh: 面试官问：方法抛了一个受检异常，数据却还是提交了，为什么？
situation.en: Spring doesn't roll back the transaction on checked exceptions unless you set rollbackFor.

entries.note: 动词分开写 roll back，名词连写 rollback。

examples.en: Logging and metrics are cross-cutting concerns, so we handle them in one aspect instead of every method.
examples.zh: 日志和监控指标属于横切关注点，所以我们在一个切面里统一处理，而不是每个方法都写一遍。

examples.en: Authorization is a cross-cutting concern that we didn't want scattered across the controllers.
examples.zh: 鉴权是横切关注点，我们不想让它散落在各个 controller 里。

situation.zh: 面试官问：AOP 适合用来解决哪类问题？
situation.en: It's a good fit for cross-cutting concerns like logging, security and transactions, which would otherwise be duplicated everywhere.

entries.note: AOP 全称 aspect-oriented programming，aspect 是“切面”。

examples.en: The method called another method on this, which bypassed the proxy, so @Transactional did nothing.
examples.zh: 这个方法通过 this 调了另一个方法，绕过了代理，所以 @Transactional 没生效。

examples.en: A call from inside the same class bypasses the proxy, so none of the advice runs.
examples.zh: 同一个类内部的调用会绕过代理，所以切面逻辑一个都不会执行。

situation.zh: 同事问：我明明加了 @Transactional，为什么在同一个类里调用这个方法时事务不生效？
situation.en: Because a call on this bypasses the proxy, and Spring applies the transaction in the proxy.

entries.note: 这种情况叫 self-invocation（自调用）。
